plugins.name: seo-skills

Keyword research, content briefing, page intelligence, technical and content audits, structured data, drift monitoring, SXO diagnostics, competitive analysis, paid search, AI-search optimization, sitemap analysis, subdomain mapping, content opportunity mining, strategic roadmap planning, local SEO (GBP / NAP / local pack), international SEO (hreflang validation), Google APIs (GSC, PSI, CrUX, Indexing, GA4, YouTube, NLP), and SE Ranking API integration recipes (Data API + Project API).
